card.name: Partway through drug names and Lao script
card.fires_on: Pieces inside longer words, such as the middle of drug or lab names (omolgus, bilirubin, donepezil) and single characters inside Lao script words.

modes.label: Inside drug and lab names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long drug, animal or lab term.

modes.label: Lao script characters
modes.description: One character in the middle of a Lao-language word, such as in a national motto.

modes.label: Error code names
modes.description: A piece of an uppercase error code in a programming manual.
modes.example: E<<INTR>> The call was interrupted by a signal.

card.plain: It fires on the middle pieces of long or unusual words, including drug names and Lao script.
